reportTemplate.summary: Signed in as admin (admin/admin) at {{v1}} and opened the 'Bench Board' project's Board view (/?controller=BoardViewController&action=show&project_id=1). The board has four columns in left-to-right order: Backlog, Ready, Work in progress, Done. Only the Backlog column contains tasks; its header shows "Task count 3 (Total number of tasks in this column across all swimlanes 3)". The three visible tasks are "Seed: triage inbox" (#1), "Seed: order missing parts" (#2) and "Seed: ship repaired device" (#3). Ready, Work in progress and Done are empty (no task elements in the DOM for those columns). Nothing was created, modified or moved.
